email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoCardolol patient with severe abdominal pain radiating to the back
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a clinical care coordinator at Demo Family Practice (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 68-year-old male patient with a history of hypertension received their first dose of DemoCardolol (dose: 50mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Approximately 2 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed severe abdominal pain radiating to the back.
The patient was hospitalized as a result.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
M. Tanaka (fictional reporter)
Demo Family Practice
Contact: demo.reporter747@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
